json.notes: Hôtel de Ville is a large rectangular Neo-Renaissance block around an inner courtyard. It has a pale stone body of about 22 m with arched windows and a ground-floor arcade of bays. Steep grey slate mansard roofs sit on top, with tall corner and mid-facade pavilions with their own steep roofs. The central clock tower (belfry, slate spire) rises on the front, with tall chimney stacks. Modelled as four wings around a court, corner pavilions with mansards, a central clock pavilion and tower, and chimney stacks.
